items.text: kuti vave varandarume navarandakadzi munyika yaJehovha.
Vachaita nhapwa vaya vaimbova vatapi vavo,
uye vachabata ushe pamusoro pavaya vaimbova vamanikidzi vavo.
Pazuva ramuchapiwa rusununguko naJehovha kubva pakutambudzika, nokusagadzikana, nokubatwa noutsinye,
Nyika dzose dzazorora uye dzava norugare;
hakuna varume vanotsvaka huni vachauya kuzotitema."
riri kumutsa mweya yavakaenda kuti izokukwazisai,
rinoita kuti vasimuke pazvigaro zvavo zvoushe,
Kuzvikudza kwako kwose kwaderedzwa kusvika muguva,
ndichagara pachigaro changu choushe pagomo reungano,
murume akaita kuti nyika ive gwenga,
Asi iwe warasirwa kunze kweguva rako,
"Ndichabvisa zita rake navakasara vake kubva kuBhabhironi,
Joko rake richabviswa kubva pavanhu vangu,
Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yakarongerwa nyika yose;
urwu ndirwo ruoko rwakatambanudzirwa pamusoro pamarudzi ose.
Nokuti Jehovha Wamasimba Ose akazvironga zvino ndianiko angamukonesa?
Shoko iri rakauya mugore rakafa Mambo Ahazi richiti:
nokuti kubva pamudzi wenyoka iyo pachabuda mvumbi,
chibereko chayo chichava nyoka ino uturu hunobaya.
Ungudza iwe suo! Chema, iwe guta!
Gore routsi riri kuuya richibva kumusoro,
uye mariri vanhu vake vanotambudzika vachawana pokuvanda."
